newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dadonghai gains five percent on debut.
newsitem.headline: Dadonghai gains five percent on debut.

text.p: Hainan Dadonghai Tourism Centre Co's B shares made a strong debut on the Shenzhen stock exchange on Tuesday, closing up nearly five percent mainly due to a low issue price, Shenzhen-based brokers said.
The shares ended at HK$1.28, or 4.92 percent up, against their issue price of HK$1.22. They opened at an intra-day high of HK$1.35 per share and hit a low of HK$1.25 on volume of 7.39 million shares.
Shenzhen brokers said the low initial offering price attracted buying, pushing up the price.
"But selling was heavy between HK$1.28 and HK$1.30," a broker with China Southern Securities told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
He said the opening price was a little too high and this triggered profit-taking.
A Shenzhen-based analyst with a foreign stock brokerage told the Bulletin that Dadonghai still had room to rise for the rest of this week.
